definitions.note: a phrase standing for a part found on a bicycle

parts.note: a cross is a combination or blend of two breeds or kinds
a bar is something that fastens or locks a door or gate

explanation.surface: A cyclist's combination padlock fixed to the bike.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Combination lock' reads as one familiar object, but it splits into two separate synonyms; the definition is the loose 'on bicycle', meaning a thing found on a bicycle.
explanation.definitionFit: The horizontal frame tube of a man's bicycle running from saddle to handlebars has this name.

indicators.note: admitting means letting something in, so one word takes the other inside it

parts.note: a worker bee is the standard crossword worker
war is armed conflict

explanation.surface: A labourer is told to steer clear of picking a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worker' is the crossword's usual insect; 'admitting' is the container signal, the worker taking in the conflict.
explanation.definitionFit: To be wary of something, as a warning, is to keep away from or avoid it.

clue.text: Old king keeps ambassador stumped with old joke

indicators.note: keeps means holds within, so the king's name contains the other pieces

parts.note: Cnut, also spelt Canute, was an eleventh-century king of England
HE, His Excellency, is the title of an ambassador
ST is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for stumped

explanation.surface: An ancient monarch holds an envoy baffled by a tired gag.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stumped' looks like bafflement but is the cricket dismissal abbreviation ST; 'keeps' puts HEST inside CNUT.
explanation.definitionFit: A stale, oft-repeated joke or story is idiomatically called by this tree-nut name.

clue.text: Small measure starts to irritate European hunting guide

parts.note: a gill is a small measure of liquid, a quarter of a pint

indicators.note: starts to means take the opening letter of each following word

explanation.surface: A tiny dram begins to annoy a European guide on a hunt.
explanation.definitionFit: In Scotland, a man who attends a hunting or fishing party as an assistant and guide has this title.

parts.note: C is a musical key
Aries is a sign of the zodiac, the Ram

explanation.surface: A crucial indication that teeth are rotting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Key sign' reads as 'crucial indicator', but splits into a musical key and a zodiac sign.
explanation.definitionFit: The dental term for decay and crumbling of teeth or bone, the cause of cavities.

clue.text: Cockscombs getting time off in civil service

indicators.note: in places the period of time off inside the civil service letters

parts.note: rest is time off from work

explanation.surface: Roosters' combs given leave within the Civil Service.
explanation.definitionFit: A cock's comb is the fleshy ridge on its head, a crest in the plural sense here.

indicators.note: endless means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: a rill is a small stream or brook

explanation.surface: The never-ending flow of thrills and delight.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden wave of pleasurable excitement or emotion, a synonym.

indicators.note: heard means the word for the chief is said aloud to give the entry

parts.note: the chief is the leader

explanation.surface: The boss's tunes were listened to.
explanation.walkthrough: In non-rhotic British speech the German word sounds like the English word for the head of a group.
explanation.definitionFit: German art songs for voice and piano, by Schubert and others, go by this plural name.

clue.text: Detects rare fusion of special expertise

indicators.note: fusion of means the letters are melted together into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A detective notes an uncommon melding of specialist skill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fusion of' rearranges the eleven letters of DETECTS and RARE.
explanation.definitionFit: A technique or know-how kept private by a business or craftsman is special knowledge.

indicators.note: exotic means foreign or strange, so the letters are made unfamiliar by rearranging

explanation.surface: Lauding a faraway ancient land.
explanation.definitionFit: The former name of Iran, an ancient empire, so a land from history.

parts.note: RE, Royal Engineers, stands for soldiers or a soldier in crosswords
to have solved a problem is to have found its answer

explanation.surface: A resolute soldier cracked the problem.
explanation.definitionFit: Having firmly made up one's mind, a synonym for being set on a course.

indicators.note: going back means the word for crazy is read backwards

parts.note: bats is slang for crazy

explanation.surface: Someone mad retreating for a blade.
explanation.definitionFit: A stab is a thrust with a blade, and to knife someone is to stab them, as verbs.

indicators.note: without in its old sense means outside, so the word for over surrounds the annoyance

parts.note: ended means over, finished
anger is annoyance

explanation.surface: Finished, and with no irritation while under threat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking' but is the old sense 'outside', so the word for over surrounds the annoyance.
explanation.definitionFit: Species described this way are at risk, in danger, under threat of extinction.

clue.text: Nurse keeps rare dog for arbiter of taste

indicators.note: keeps means holds within, so the verb for nurse contains the letter

parts.note: to tend is to nurse or care for
a setter is a breed of gundog

explanation.surface: A nurse looks after an unusual hound, as a fashion arbiter might.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who leads the way in fashion, whose style others copy, judges what is in good taste.

parts.note: seems to mean someone who hardly enjoys nature, but barely means while bare, unclothed

explanation.definitionFit: A nudist enjoys fresh air and nature without clothing, appreciating it in a bare state.

indicators.note: injured means damaged, so the letters are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: Wounded mythical horse-men harm an ancient Italian.
explanation.definitionFit: A person of ancient Etruria, the pre-Roman civilisation of central Italy.

clue.text: Animal in South Dakota is carved up

indicators.note: in places the animal inside the state abbreviation

parts.note: SD is the postal abbreviation for South Dakota
a hare is an animal

explanation.surface: A creature in a US state is butchered.
explanation.definitionFit: Something carved up has been divided out among people, portioned.

indicators.note: in places the praise inside the church letters

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
to laud is to praise

explanation.surface: An artist receives acclaim in a church.
explanation.definitionFit: Claude Lorrain was a seventeenth-century French landscape artist known by his first name.

definitions.meaning: the pair of eating sticks used in East Asian dining
read as two words, to chop up sticks for burning

explanation.definitionFit: Paired eating sticks, also readable as cutting small branches into kindling.

clue.text: Dance Virginia enters through the window

indicators.note: enters means goes into, so the state letters go inside the glass

parts.note: a pane is a sheet of window glass

explanation.surface: A dancer from Virginia comes in through the window.
explanation.definitionFit: A stately sixteenth-century court dance in slow duple time.

parts.note: a bob was a pre-decimal British shilling, abbreviated S
ample means big, generous

explanation.surface: Elderly Bob's major examination.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bob' looks like a man's name; it is the slang for a shilling, a coin of Britain's money before 1971, abbreviated S.
explanation.definitionFit: To try out a small portion of something is to test it, as verbs.

indicators.note: keeping means holding, so the regret word contains the letter

parts.note: to rue is to regret
a sovereign is a pound coin, and L is the abbreviation for pound

explanation.surface: Remorse is kept by a monarch in power.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sovereign' suggests a monarch but is the gold pound coin, abbreviated L.
explanation.definitionFit: Authority or control over a realm, a synonym in the sense of governing.

clue.text: Reject paintings and poetry being cross

indicators.note: reject means throw back, so the word for paintings is turned around

parts.note: art means paintings collectively
verse is poetry

explanation.surface: Turning down pictures and verse makes someone angry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cross' looks like 'angry' but is the verb, to go across; 'Reject' turns ART to TRA.
explanation.definitionFit: To traverse land is to travel across it, a verb synonym.

parts.note: a mess is a communal meal, as in a military mess
up means in residence at university

explanation.surface: Spoiling a dinner while at college.
explanation.definitionFit: To spoil or botch something completely, a phrasal verb synonym.

clue.text: Beautiful woman embraces a partner from Scandinavia

indicators.note: embraces means hugs, so the woman holds the other letters

parts.note: a dish is slang for an attractive person
N, North, is a bridge partner of South

explanation.surface: A lovely woman hugs a companion from Scandinavia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'partner' is a compass point at the bridge table: North partners South.
explanation.definitionFit: Coming from Denmark, a Scandinavian country, as an adjective.

indicators.note: leader means the opening letter of the word before it

parts.note: leave is time off work, a holiday

explanation.surface: The Tory leader takes a break that is cut short.
explanation.definitionFit: To cleave is to split or chop apart, a verb synonym.
